summary: Configured firewalld on node1 (RHEL 9) to permit only SSH (22/tcp) and TCP 8080 inbound, removed the extraneous cockpit service, and verified persistence across a full node restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS and firewall tooling (RHEL 9.8, firewalld active/enabled)
Captured baseline firewalld config (public zone: cockpit, dhcpv6-client, ssh services; no custom ports)
Removed --permanent cockpit service from public zone and added --permanent 8080/tcp
Reloaded firewalld and verified runtime config matches: services=dhcpv6-client,ssh; ports=8080/tcp
Verified at nft ruleset level that filter_IN_public_allow only accepts tcp dport 22, tcp dport 8080, and ipv6 dhcpv6 (fe80::/64 udp 546), with a trailing reject admin-prohibited for everything else
Captured boot_id baseline, triggered systemctl reboot on node1 (ack returned before disconnect), polled until exec succeeded again
Confirmed boot_id changed (583ddd53-...-> b519ab7d-...), proving an actual restart occurred

Post-reboot: verified firewalld active+enabled, firewall-cmd --list-all matches pre-reboot config, nft ruleset identical (SSH+8080 allow, rest rejected), sshd active and listening, and this exec session's own connectivity proves SSH access survived the restart

evidence.requirement: Baseline: identify OS/firewall tooling and pre-existing firewalld state on node1
evidence.summary: RHEL 9.8 with firewalld active; baseline public zone allowed cockpit, dhcpv6-client, ssh with no custom ports; boot_id captured as baseline

evidence.requirement: Enable persistent firewall permitting SSH and TCP 8080, rejecting unrelated inbound
evidence.summary: Removed cockpit service, added 8080/tcp permanently, reloaded; firewall-cmd --list-all shows services=dhcpv6-client,ssh and ports=8080/tcp

evidence.requirement: Direct proof unrelated inbound is rejected while SSH/8080 are allowed
evidence.summary: nft ruleset shows filter_IN_public_allow only accepts tcp dport 22 and tcp dport 8080 (plus ipv6 dhcpv6 client), with reject admin-prohibited catching everything else in filter_IN_public

evidence.requirement: Persistence across restart: enabled at boot
evidence.summary: systemctl is-enabled firewalld = enabled; pre-reboot boot_id and rule state captured as healthy baseline

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded systemctl reboot via nohup/disown so the exec ack returned before the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node restart proof via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Polling showed connection timeout/reset during reboot, then successful exec returning a new boot_id (b519ab7d-...) differing from the pre-reboot baseline (583ddd53-...)

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required firewall service and rules
evidence.summary: After restart, firewalld active+enabled with identical zone config (ssh, dhcpv6-client services, 8080/tcp port); nft ruleset identical to pre-reboot; sshd active and listening, with this exec session itself proving SSH connectivity survived the restart
